resolved_audit_findings.issue: The pre-v8 shared post-trim sample clock produced 2046 differing float values for inherited negative fades, including after returning a retimed fragment to 1x.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: After choosing an explicit 1/sample-rate audio timebase, the shared renderer resets PTS directly to integer sample N. The recipe is v8; current legacy and canonical full/bounded controls are exact.
resolved_audit_findings.distinction: This confirmed renderer defect is separate from initial test/compiler/helper instrumentation failures and from older sharp-pulse and two-sample diagnostics.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: Backward trim after first retime incorrectly rejected a retained conversion origin later than source_in.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Retained physical conversion origin remains fixed. Validation allows the signed source phase within existing timeline bounds.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: A source_in-only or same projected duration patch could discard a fractional retained tail after 7/6 speed.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Only a deliberately changed duration defines a new span. A changed source_in resets conversion origin while preserving exact span; a no-op patch preserves both.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: Retiming the right half of a split could move its compositing group anchor and change an existing overlay order.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Stored composition offset scales by new speed / old speed; offset / speed keeps the same sequence anchor. Physical source conversion origin is separate.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: Imported canonical metadata could disagree with displayed keyframes, fades or composition offset.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Validation derives the expected projection and rejects mismatched controls before committing or rendering the project.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: No-op fade patches and keyframe reorder could replace inherited fade anchors and hidden fractional canonical control points.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Only changed fade values reset anchors. Sorted per-property keyframes compare logical changes; no-op reordering preserves exact canonical keys.

resolved_audit_findings.issue: Legacy native rendering fixtures used mixed generic speed patches whose old semantics conflict with retained-span retiming.
resolved_audit_findings.resolution: Speed-only legacy commands route to the atomic retime operation; mixed speed/property patches are explicitly rejected. Historical test sources were preserved before fixture migration.

transaction.conclusion: ProjectStore clones pending state; validation and atomic recovery persistence precede history and project mutation.

repeated_retime.conclusion: Repeated rational rates preserve retained source interval and canonical envelopes; UI frame projections do not become source ownership.

split_trim_property_edit.conclusion: Split and trim preserve canonical source clocks; an explicit property edit replaces only that property envelope.

linked_extract_slip.conclusion: Linked A/V retimes atomically, keeps fixed source offsets, and restores through one Undo. Audio extraction retains volume automation and its source clock; duplicate/unlink/slip retain or reset documented ownership.

collisions.conclusion: Retiming keeps neighbors fixed and rejects new or increased same-track overlap, locked or missing linked media, mismatched linked starts/rates, and invalid explicit ranges.

frontend_invalidation.conclusion: The actual render descriptor includes canonical fields. Source-level production controller tests verify retime invalidation, Stop tombstones, late-work rejection and Undo identity cache reuse.
